title: Cinnamon Swirls
description: Light puff pastry rolled up with cinnamon and sweetener, sliced into swirls and baked until crisp and golden.
steps: Preheat the oven to 190ºC (fan 170ºC/gas mark 5) and line a baking tray with baking parchment. Unroll the pastry and moisten with the cold water.
Sprinkle over the granulated sweetener, followed by the cinnamon to form an even layer.
Roll the pastry along the long edge, to form a long roll. Try to keep the roll as tight as possible. Use a little water along the far edge to help the roll stick together.
Cut into thirty-two pieces – a bread knife is good for this – and place each swirl onto the baking tray.
Press each swirl down a little to help the pastry layers stick together.  Brush each swirl with a little milk and bake for 20 minutes until crisp and golden.
Leave to cool on a wire rack and enjoy! You can also freeze the swirls to have later.
